THE RADAR 🇬🇧 — Season 25

"SHOTTA'S." went from a TikTok snippet to a seven-figure deal for one song. Self-released on TuneCore on 25 September, it's now #1 on the Official Hip Hop & R&B Singles Chart and #17 on the Official Singles Chart (20–26 Nov, up from #23). In Germany it enters the official chart at #16. The deal, announced on 12 Nov, is with Isekai Records and broke Records.

BEHIND THE BEAT 🇮🇹 — Dat Boi Dee

The beat on Frezza's "7/7" comes from Naples: Dat Boi Dee co-produced it with Manuel Erry. The track hit #18 on Spotify Italy's weekly chart (w/e 12 Nov, 688K streams). Dat Boi Dee, real name Davide Totaro, is also behind Geolier's "Narcos", Samurai Jay's "Gang" and his own "Vamos pa la banca" with Geolier, Samurai Jay and Lele Blade. His reference: early-2000s US production.
